in_marathi.name: Mahendri
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mahendri हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'maha' meaning great and 'indra' referring to the king of gods.

in_bengali.long_meaning: Mahendri একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'maha' meaning great and 'indra' referring to the king of gods.
